description: Exercise authorized, missing and excluded tickets across all seven protected reads.
Compare compiled and record decisions with real tenant-scoped PostgreSQL records, including portal comment rules, mixed results, unsupported rules and resolver failure.
Verify delayed PostgreSQL pagination with a denied prefix, later readable hits, exact counts, unique pages and termination.
Benchmark baseline and revised typeahead and later pages with equivalent results on a representative large fixture and report p95 and SQL statements per request for broad and restricted access.
